name: Cloudstrike

frame.name: Mortal Polarity
frame.description: Precision final blows generate a lightning bolt at the target's location and grant a moderate amount of Bolt Charge.

perks.name: Fluted Barrel
perks.description:
Ultra-light barrel. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Alloy Magazine
perks.description: Faster reload when the magazine is nearly empty.

perks.name: Stormbringer
perks.description: Rapid precision hits create a lightning storm at the point of impact and grant a stack of Bolt Charge.

perks.name: Hand-Laid Stock
perks.description:
This weapon is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Increases stability

flavor: They return to moons devoid. Their eyes searching. It's just begun. Meet this storm of sound and fury, till thunder-clashes fade to silence.

catalyst.name: Cloudstrike Catalyst
catalyst.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.
